description: This file defines a data structure 'BufferProtectionMetadata' used for handling media buffer protection metadata, including encryption details, and declares a function 'ProcessProtectionMetadata' for processing such metadata in GStreamer buffers.

classes.name: BufferProtectionMetadata
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates metadata related to media buffer encryption, including encryption status, key session ID, initialization vectors, subsamples, and encryption scheme details.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: A function that processes a GStreamer buffer to extract and populate BufferProtectionMetadata information.
